users.bio: Always looking for good coffee, new photo spots, and people to explore campus with.
Design student who loves quiet cafés. Looking for genuine campus friendships.
Film photographer, weekend hiker, always down for a late-night noodle run.
Psych student who loves long walks, podcasts, and trying every dessert place in Kennedy Town.
Basketball, running, weekend hikes, and the search for the best post-workout meal.

voice_intro.transcript: Hey, I'm Zane. I'm usually on the basketball court or out for a run, and I love a good weekend hike. The best part after a workout? Finding a cozy little place for a great meal. Got any hidden gems? Come tell me about them.

users.bio: Usually carrying a camera, a pair of headphones, and no reason to rush sunset.

voice_intro.transcript: Hi, I'm Linden. I'm into photography, music, and slow walks around sunset. I can be a little quiet at first, but once I warm up, I always have plenty to say. What song have you had on repeat lately? Send it my way.

users.bio: Movie nights, improvised recipes, and spontaneous plans are my favorite combination.

voice_intro.transcript: Hey, I'm Evan. I love movies and experimenting in the kitchen. My signature dish is scrambled eggs with tomatoes—still a work in progress. Some days I stay in; other days I take off on a whim. I'm hoping to meet someone who enjoys the little fun moments in life.

users.bio: Always ready for a new exhibition, a photo walk, or a place with something delicious.

voice_intro.transcript: Hey! I'm Coco. I love checking out exhibitions, taking photos, and hunting down delicious food. My friends say I laugh at almost anything, so it doesn't take much to make my day. What's the funniest thing that's happened to you lately? Come share it with me!

users.bio: A quiet-day person who is happiest with a book, a playlist, and a good cup of coffee.

voice_intro.transcript: Hi, I'm Anna. On a quiet day, you'll find me reading, listening to music, or making myself a cup of coffee. I may seem a little reserved when we first meet, but give me time and you'll see another side of me. I'm hoping to meet someone I can talk to with ease.

users.bio: Equally happy planning the next trip or wandering through town with nowhere to be.

voice_intro.transcript: Hey, I'm Bella. I love traveling, but I also enjoy wandering around town on my own. I'm pretty easygoing, but when something matters to me, I give it my full attention. If you're into trying new things too, I think we'll have plenty to talk about.

users.bio: Usually debugging in the library, then taking the long way home with my camera. Looking for someone to trade playlists and late-night noodle recommendations with.
Psychology lectures, second-hand bookshops, and very long coffee chats. I am trying a different café every Sunday; happy to share the list.
I help with student radio and take film-night snacks a little too seriously. Always looking for a new album or an easy recipe to try with friends.
Economics by day, five-a-side football when the assignments allow it. I like plans that start with a quick coffee and somehow turn into a whole afternoon.
My tote bag is mostly sketchbooks and forgotten receipts. I would love a museum buddy or someone happy to sit by the sea and draw badly together.
Training for my first 10K without giving up weekend dim sum. Happy to find an easy running partner, especially one who knows a good breakfast stop.
Architecture studio has taught me to notice windows and survive on noodles. On free weekends I explore a new neighborhood and photograph its signs.
The friend who makes the shared map before a trip. I am collecting favorite bakeries around Hong Kong and trying to get better at conversational Cantonese.
Illustration student, cozy-game enthusiast, and enthusiastic collector of stationery. I am quieter in big groups but always up for a small creative afternoon.
Data projects during the week, dance practice after class. Looking for a study partner who will also celebrate finishing an assignment with bubble tea.
I volunteer at weekend reading sessions and rarely say no to an outdoor plan. New to campus gigs and very open to recommendations.
I build small apps, overthink film endings, and make a surprisingly decent curry. Hoping to meet people for relaxed dinners and the occasional board-game night.
Finishing my final year and trying to spend less of it in spreadsheets. I like practical books, morning workouts, and hearing what people are building.
Usually recording sounds for a class project or taking a train somewhere new. Looking for gig buddies and people who enjoy getting a little lost.
I keep a very serious list of very inexpensive lunches. My ideal plan is a market walk, something new to eat, and a conversation that forgets the time.
Law student trying to read something that is not a case report. I love unhurried walks, good pastries, and people who ask thoughtful questions.
Science labs, sci-fi novels, and board games with overly long rulebooks. Patient enough to explain the rules and equally happy to learn something new.
I like gentle hikes with lots of photo stops and a proper lunch afterward. Looking for friends who enjoy the quieter side of campus life.
Making short videos for the student arts club and playlists for every bus ride. Always up for an open mic, even if I am only cheering from the audience.
A design student who notices shopfront colors before street names. I would love company for photo walks, gallery afternoons, and finding a new lunch spot.
I swap books with friends and try to make time for a walk every day. Looking for kind conversation, language practice, and someone to explore cafés with.
I fix things in the workshop and take slow routes home. Keen to meet people for casual games, seaside walks, and a good meal after a long day.
Architecture student with a soft spot for old courtyards and handwritten postcards. Looking for a walking buddy who does not mind a few sketching stops.
